pageCache.text:
Welcome To The Serendipity Centre
The Serendipity Centre Limited (TSCL) is a small care company based on the north-east edge of Southampton which comprises of a school, three care homes and a therapeutic team. TSCL is now under new management. This new senior management team is made up of predominantly seasoned practitioners who have devoted most of their professional careers to specialising within the complex field of specialist education or providing quality residential care. This management team are clear on the importance of working in ‘partnership’ with a foundation which allows us to design and build a service around the individual needs of children.
We have no ambition to become one of the care giants currently monopolising the care industry. However, we do have an ambition to deliver a quality care package in education and care and acknowledge the importance of evidencing each young person’s progress as well as their outcomes to placing authorities, the young people themselves, as well as their families.
What People Think of Us
Pupils flourish at this superb school. Extremely skilled staff quickly build caring, professional relationships with pupils. This develops trust and increases pupils’ involvement in education.
Leaders and those responsible for governance are highly ambitious for pupils. They have high expectations of themselves, staff and pupils. They have a shared vision for what excellence looks like.

pageCache.pageTitle: GCSE Results 2024/25 – The Serendipity Centre Limited
pageCache.text:
GCSE Results 2024/25
Welcome
GCSE Results 2024/25
All students who are able to sit GCSE exams are encouraged to do so during their time at The Serendipity School, and it is something we are really proud of. We are aware that for many students the thought of sitting externally assessed and moderated exams is daunting and something that they may not have envisaged for themselves when they first started their journey with us.
Our results are based on a small cohort of 5 students for year 11, and in the academic year 2024/25, 80% of these students achieved pass grades at GCSE.
Given the needs of our cohorts, GCSE grades can be variable year to year, for the period 2024/25 the pass rates and highest grades for each subject were as follows:
English has a 100% pass rate, the highest grade being a grade 6. Maths has an 80% pass rate, highest grade 5. Science has 100% pass rate, highest grade 5. Art 100% pass rate, highest grade 6. Food Technology 100% pass rate, highest grade 2.
All 5 students entered for exams, have achieved at least 3 nationally recognised qualifications, with some achieving over 5 which is the national standard.
All 5 students were able to access college courses locally, or continue with bespoke education programmes outside of mainstream education.
As a school we are always proud of the achievements of our students whatever their results as we know their journey and effort they have made in their time with us.

Career Opportunities
Career Opportunities
Could you be a mentor to a young person with challenging behaviours?
We are a growing company who provide Specialist Children ’s Residential Care, Education and Therapy for young people (girls aged 9-18) who present with challenging social, emotional and mental health needs. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare and education of young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
We are always looking for dynamic individuals seeking a career working with young people, who can be part of a team committed to providing each young person with a safe and supportive environment where their needs are put first. The work will be varied and interesting and you will find yourself involved in every aspect of our young people’s lives: including practical, hands on activities, offering vital emotional, guidance and support.
We want all of our employees to be committed, reliable, safe and positive role models for the young people we care for. Working at The Serendipity Centre Ltd can be challenging but also hugely rewarding to see the positive impact of the work that we do.
You will need a passion for working with young people, enthusiasm and determination.
For positions within education and all other departments informal interviews will be arranged on an individual basis. Please download the forms below, if you are applying for a role working in our Care homes and send them to recruitment@serendipity-education.com.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Head Teacher – The Serendipity Centre Limited
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Head Teacher
Welcome
Welcome from the Head Teacher
I joined The Serendipity School in 2011, as English teacher, before moving in the role of SENCo, and being appointed as Head Teacher in November 2021. It is a real honour to be part of such an amazing school, and I feel very proud to be leading such an outstanding team of practitioners.
We have a highly skilled staff team that enables our students to build secure attachments, and confidence in order for them to engage with learning and reach their full potential. We strive to foster positive relationships with students, building trust, safety and resilience across all aspects of education. The secure foundations we create in positive relationships enables us to teach the social and emotional skills needed for our young people to move to positive destinations, fulfil their potential and build skills for life long success. We support families, parents and carers, and work closely in partnership with other agencies to overcome life’s challenges, and to ensure our students have opportunities to succeed. We firmly uphold the belief that special educational needs are no barrier for achievement and success, and that all students are entitled to an education which allows them to be successful in many different ways. We believe a strong team around a student is essential for them to thrive and be successful.
We offer a non-judgemental approach to every student who attends The Serendipity School and ensure we have an excellent understanding of their individual needs. We provide a personalised approach and curriculum for every student. Our curriculum offer is diverse and holds high expectations for learning and behaviour; however, we place a great emphasis on each student’s personal development journey. The combination of a broad academic and personal development curriculum, an understanding of mental health and well-being, alongside strong pastoral support, provides our students the right balance of nurture and challenge.
Through building emotional resilience and ensuring all our young people achieve outstanding outcomes, we ensure that all students are prepared for the world outside of school, allowing them to be successful individuals.

Our School Day
The Serendipity School operates extended opening hours from 8.30am – 2.45pm for all students following a full time offer. The school day is arranged as follows:
For students who are new to the school, or who have been out of mainstream education for a period of time, we offer a transitional timetable with flexible hours to support the individual student back in to formal education.
On Friday afternoons, we run ‘STAR Time’ for all students who have achieved their personal STAR point target during the week. STAR Time and STAR points are the heart of our behaviour management and academic achievement system whereby students understand the consequences of the choices they make. STAR Time involves activities both on and off site.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Serendipity Education School – The Serendipity Centre Limited
pageCache.text:
The Serendipity Education School
The Serendipity Education School is a small, independent school providing specialist, therapeutic provision combined with outstanding education for girls aged 9 to 19 years old. Rated as Outstanding by Ofsted and recognised as a Centre of Excellence, our highly skilled staff provide a safe, nurturing environment which ensures all of our girls flourish and achieve exceptional outcomes.
The experienced and well-qualified staff team provide an outstanding education for girls with high anxiety, Social, Emotional and Mental Health (SEMH) needs; Autistic Spectrum Conditions (ASC); Attachment Disorder; Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs); Learning Difficulties; Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD); Speech, Language and Communication Needs (SLCN) and complex needs.
Our students often arrive with a disrupted educational experience, school phobia, lengthy periods of time out of school or having struggled where their needs have not previously been met. Through staff expertise in Trauma Informed Practices and a nationally recognised unique programme of assessing and teaching Emotional Literacy, The Serendipity Education School provides the rare opportunity for girls to feel the security needed to learn personally identified life-success skills. The combination of this approach, our team of specialist therapists and psychologists, our bespoke educational programmes and our high staff-to-student ratio offers our girls the opportunity to begin to regain confidence in their own ability, build self-esteem and resilience and reignite enjoyment in learning through positive experiences.
We provide an ambitious, challenging and personalised curriculum where we respond to our students’ diverse learning needs, help them overcome barriers to learning, celebrate success in all aspects of their lives and ensure the best possible outcomes.
The school is situated on the outskirts of Southampton, registered for up to 20 students and, as part of The Serendipity Centre, we also have the ability to provide residential places for children who are looked after if this is required.

The Therapy Team consists of:
The team is involved in the referral process, and pays particular attention to transitions, as well as gaining an understanding of the young person through a multi-agency and multidisciplinary approach. The team also undertake initial assessments, in order, to establish the young person’s level of need and therapeutic intervention.
The therapeutic approach is based in Attachment Theory. The main ethos behind our approach is working in the ‘present’ moment and this transcends the whole service. Some of the interventions include: “Mindfulness”, “Mentalisation”, “Emotion Regulation”, and “Reflective Practice”.
The Therapy Team is fully integrated at a whole service level; delivering training, supervision and promoting overall organisational health.

Safeguarding is a key priority and of paramount importance at The Serendipity Centre Ltd
The core of our ethos is a whole-team approach and, as a result, safeguarding and the welfare of our girls is embedded in our culture and daily lives. Our pro-active approach creates a caring, friendly and safe environment; and both young people and the staff team are supported by a dedicated safeguarding team.
The use of skilled and highly-consistent behaviour management by all the team helps create a culture of care, learning and keeping safe.
The girls are actively involved in shaping all the decisions that affect their lives and they are supported to achieve their full potential.
